sections.title: A mini undertone session does not confirm a full season
sections.html:
Saskatoon has a clear example of why “colour analysis” is not one uniform product. A short introduction to undertone is different from a full seasonal consultation, and a makeup lesson adds another layer. Choose the level around what you need to learn rather than selecting the cheapest label.

KR Studio

KR Studio lists a C$99 mini lasting 15–30 minutes that excludes full season confirmation, a palette and makeup guidance. Its C$195 Essential session lasts 60–90 minutes and includes seasonal draping and a palette card. The C$295 Signature and C$395 Full experiences add further services.

sections.title: Before booking in Saskatoon
sections.html:
If you want a season and a reference for shopping, check that the booking includes both. If you need help applying makeup, ask whether you will practise or only receive recommendations. The menu also lists a physical wallet separately, so confirm that extra before comparing totals. Check which digital materials are ready now rather than relying on anything marked as coming soon.

  • Does this session confirm a season and include a palette?
  • Are a makeup lesson and physical swatch wallet included or extra?

sections.title: Make the result useful in your everyday wardrobe
sections.html: An app can be a starting point for exploring your palette and previewing colors. A live consultation can help when you want an explanation using physical drapes or a hands-on makeup lesson. After either route, test one neutral and two accents with your current wardrobe. Save the questions that remain instead of booking a second analysis simply because you want more certainty from a season name.
